name: one-message-into-a-kind-without-a-run-line-keeps-its-inner-kind
reference: spec 0.94 ruling 7: kind p, which has no run line, takes the one message and is checked as convert, ruling 4 included: the message's inner kind p of in-ping names the format of kind p's plain `inner` line, so it is kept and nothing is checked, although the joined entity holds only w; written as when 1, length 1, message 01
